reuse.why: All affected consumers reuse getDateWithSkippedWeekend and recurConfigToRSchedule, although occurrence-resolution adapters remain separately implemented.

duplication.why: The substantive calendar rules are shared, but enabling adjustment and converting its nullable result to a day string recur across three modules.

placement.why: Calendar policy stays in shared/schedules.ts, configuration metadata flows through rule parsing, and handler registration stays in the schedule server.

scope.why: The changes address the four requested scheduling extensions and their affected consumers without unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: The shared non-working-day predicate keeps holiday formats centralized, though repeated adapters and the budget adapter's handwritten configuration type add maintenance overhead.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All changed weekend and holiday adjustment paths call the existing shared getDateWithSkippedWeekend helper.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated adjustment wrappers are straightforward adapters; the daily, weekend, and holiday rules are centralized rather than disguised.

abstraction_drift.where: getDateWithSkippedWeekend gains frequency and holidays parameters and a daily-frequency branch returning null; these additions represent requested variation, and all changed adjustment consumers use it.
